new_value: DONE: the GCP-5 RPL Multi-Instance Coordination section expanded from the 6-bullet skeleton into normative text (commits 2b077f8535 + the review-fixes commit): GCP-5.1 single instance / multi-root framing (RFC 6550 §2 DODAG identity model, unified_dodag_view contract, key-derived DODAGID per gateway), GCP-5.2 root selection + conflict resolution (deterministic, pinned by ccp16-desync vectors and the root-selection fixtures, with all three reference implementations named), GCP-5.3 DAO propagation across the backbone (aggregation, trust gating per GCP-3, staleness per appendix-rpl), GCP-5.4 desync/rejoin interplay (DESYNCED semantics applied to a root's own DIO origination), GCP-5.5 security properties (key-derived identity, multi-root diversity, backbone trust boundary), GCP-5.6 references. REVIEWER (kimi-k3, 2 passes): pass 1 (spec-correctness) verified all cross-references resolve and no contradictions with GCP-6.5/2a.5/2a.6; pass 2 surfaced 4 findings — all applied: (4) the 'same logical DODAG' framing misused RFC 6550's DODAG-identity model — reframed as one instance with one DODAG per gateway and a unified node view; (5) capability re-announce now cites GCP-4.1 (the announcement mechanism) instead of GCP-6; (6) RPLInstanceID=0 now cites the draft directly (appendix-rpl is a pointer page); (7) the gateway-side desync framing now defines which 2a.6 role a desynced root occupies. Doc-only change; markdown structure verified.
